title: SvgFeFuncG
responsibility: Renders the native feFuncG element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeFuncG.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet rendered inside the native `feFuncG` element when supplied; when absent, no child content is rendered. It is invoked directly, with no transformation or wrapper.

outputs.name: SvgFeFuncG
outputs.description: A single native SVG `feFuncG` element with the remaining props spread onto it and optional children rendered inside. The component adds no wrapper or behavior beyond that element.
